_comment: Per-target plugin bundle layout: where the hooks file lives inside a plugin bundle, and which environment variable the client sets to the plugin's root before running a hook. Facts, not behaviour. Sourced from the bundles chock builds (observed 2026-09-05) and agentseam's vendor facts; `basis` names that observation, not a live measurement of the client itself. `manifest` is the plugin manifest whose `hooks` field may name hooks files at other paths (a string, a list of strings, or an inline hooks object); only Claude Code's is documented (Claude Code plugins reference), so only it is recorded. Observed in the wild 2026-09-06: aws-core and azure in anthropics/claude-plugins-official declare hooks only through that field.
